The '''Oolex Pulsar''' was a bright [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]],<ref name="GaW" /> a rapidly rotating [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron star]],<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> located in the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The intensity of the professional rivalry between [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and [[Sun Guard]] factions could be viewed as surpassing the brightness of the Oolex Pulsar.<ref name="GaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Oolex Pulsar was first mentioned in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[2009]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]''.<ref name="GaW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the 2009 reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', later placed it in grid square N-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
